body: FFA path only, deliberately. SHANKPIT's own draw_tab_scoreboard also has a team-mode (TDM/CTF) branch, but shankpit-460's GameMode enum never gained SHANKPIT's post-fork 'B'/'O' bot-compatible team variants and PlayerState.team_id is declared but never assigned anywhere in this codebase (confirmed by grep). Porting team-mode UI on top of nonexistent team assignment would be a hollow display, so scoped to FFA only, which has real live-tracked data (kills/deaths, confirmed incremented in packages/simulation/local_game.h, working live in the bot regression test's own per-bot columns). Verified visually via a temporary throwaway build (TAB-gate bypassed, never touching committed source -- confirmed via grep after) run against a real server under Xvfb: panel/border/header/columns all render correctly. Real server+bot regression test also PASS on the actual committed binary. Team-mode scoreboard stays open, flagged not dropped. Commit 4ba4e94.
title: S169-10: TAB-held scoreboard backported from SHANKPIT (FFA path)
